ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe from? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe from.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe from.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe from.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe from.

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of heat in? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of heat in.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of heat in.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of heat in.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of heat in.

8. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals and its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals and its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals and its resources.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Heat and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Heat and its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Heat and its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Heat and its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Heat and its resources.

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe in? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe in.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe in.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe in.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe in.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Plants and its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants and its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants and its resources.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and its resources.

16. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water environment collecting rain water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Caring For Energy environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping safe from and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Water its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
